headline: Ukraine peace-talk odds surge while the Iran ceasefires crack
summary: Odds of Russia–Ukraine peace talks by year-end jumped 28 pts to 72.5%. At the same time, the Israel–Iran and US–Iran ceasefires lost 8–12 pts across later dates, and Iran fully closing its airspace by year-end jumped to 41%. Anthropic's IPO now looks likely in November, Canada is 83% to raise rates next week, and long-shot whales doubled down on a Republican midterm sweep.

takeaways.lead: Ukraine peace talks are suddenly likely.
takeaways.text: Russia–Ukraine peace talks by Nov 30 jumped 31 pts in a day to 63%, and by Dec 31 jumped 28 to 72.5% ($456k market). An actual ceasefire is slower: about 60–70% by mid-to-late 2027. Russia's central bank cutting rates this month rose 14 pts to 20.5% (thin market). One trader also sold $51k of 'Putin stays through 2026', a long-shot bet (2.1%).

The US–Iran ceasefire through Oct 31 fell 8 pts to 73.5%, and through Nov 8 fell 10 to 59.5%. Israel–Iran through Nov 15 fell 9 to 59.5%, and through Nov 30 fell 12 to 48%. Iran fully closing its airspace by year-end jumped 12 pts to 41% ($10M market), often a sign of expected strikes. Some large money still bet $38k on the US–Iran truce holding through Oct 24.

takeaways.lead: Anthropic's IPO is now pencilled in for November.
takeaways.text: An Anthropic IPO by Nov 30 rose 9 pts to 72%, and by Dec 31 rose 9 to 87.5% (up 13 this week). 'IPO in November' is 72% (thin market). Celonis listing before 2027 also jumped 38 pts to 46% (thin $211k market).

takeaways.lead: Long-shot whales doubled down on a Republican sweep.
takeaways.text: About $97k more went on Republicans winning both chambers at 9¢, on top of $50k yesterday. The market still says only 7.5%, and a Democratic sweep rose 4 pts to 67.5%. About $86k of large bets went on Republicans winning Texas's Senate seat at about 34¢.

takeaways.lead: Canada's hike is almost locked in.
takeaways.text: A Bank of Canada hike on Oct 28 rose another 11 pts to 83% (up 64 this week). The US Fed is still expected to hold on Oct 29 (88.5%, with $89k of large bets on it) and hike in December (78.5%).

takeaways.lead: Overlooked: big bets on Bitcoin and data centers.
takeaways.text: One trader put $229k on Bitcoin NOT dipping to $50k this year. Another put about $102k on Indiana banning new data centers by end-2027, a contrarian bet on a 14.5% market. Data center bans would hit AI power demand and utility stocks.

sections.title: What's new today
bullets: Serbia: about $145k of large bets went on the student list winning the most seats at about 34¢. Vučić is still the favorite at 67.5%.
Israel: Bennett jumped 6 pts to 18% as next prime minister. Eizenkot 49.5% (down 2), Netanyahu 26.5%.
Toronto's mayoral race is now a coin flip: Chow 49% (down 15 today), Bradford 49.5% (up 14).

sections.title: Trading signals
bullets: Oil: after touching $100, WTI reaching $105 this month is 42% (down 5), and $110 16%. Ceasefire trouble could quickly reverse that.
Rates: Canada hike 83%, Fed hold 88.5%, Fed December hike 78.5%.
AI and tech: the Anthropic IPO is likely in November (72% by Nov 30). Apple as the largest company at year-end rose 8 pts to 28%.
Bitcoin: large bets of $229k against a dip to $50k and $21k against reaching $110k mean traders expect a range for the rest of the year.

sections.title: Wars & geopolitics
bullets: Israel–Iran ceasefire through Dec 31 fell 9 pts to 37.5% ($1.2M traded on that date).
Iran full airspace closure by year-end: 41% (up 12). US invades Iran before 2027: 15.5%, with about $35k of large bets on 'no'.
Russia–Ukraine: talks by year-end 72.5% (up 28). A ceasefire by mid-2027 is about 60%.

sections.title: Elections that move markets
bullets: Brazil (Sunday, Oct 25): Bolsonaro 78.5% (down 2), Lula 21.5%. About $33k more of large bets went on Bolsonaro.
US midterms (Nov 3): Democratic sweep 67.5% (up 4), Republican Senate with Democratic House 23.5% (down 4). Large bets: $68k on Democrats taking the House.

sections.title: Everyday life
bullets: Gas: oil is off its peak, but the Iran ceasefire risk is rising again, so don't expect pump prices to fall yet.
Canadian borrowers: a rate hike next week is 83% likely.
2026 is now 85% likely to be the hottest year on record (up 14 pts this week).
